subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should OpenClaw escalate repeated Telegram/gateway unresponsiveness to process-level supervisor recovery, or keep recovery bounded to channel/session restarts until current-main Windows proof identifies a narrower fault?
rationale: The source shows bounded channel restart behavior and partial Telegram mitigations, but process exit or broader recovery changes affect active sessions and operator expectations and cannot be chosen safely from source inspection alone.

options.title: Reproduce Before Escalating
options.body: Collect current-main affected-host Windows logs and health/status/Telegram API probes, then choose the smallest recovery behavior that fixes the observed stall.

options.title: Adopt Supervisor Recovery
options.body: Treat repeated channel restart exhaustion plus gateway RPC timeout as an unhealthy process state and document that supervised installs may restart the gateway.

options.title: Keep Channel-Local Recovery
options.body: Leave process lifetime unchanged and continue landing only narrower Telegram polling, retry, and transport repairs as separate issues prove them.

recommendation.title: Reproduce Before Escalating
recommendation.body: Collect current-main affected-host Windows logs and health/status/Telegram API probes, then choose the smallest recovery behavior that fixes the observed stall.

likelyOwner.reason: They already drove the targeted live Telegram repro and requested the exact affected-host evidence needed for the recovery decision.
